**Proposed mechanism:** HEPACAM (HGNC:26361) —DISRUPTS→ Cell adhesion and migration (GO:0007155); Cell adhesion and migration (GO:0007155) —LEADS_TO→ Leukodystrophy (HP:0002176); Cell adhesion and migration (GO:0007155) —LEADS_TO→ Subcortical cyst (HP:0012735); Cell adhesion and migration (GO:0007155) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal cerebral white matter morphology (HP:0012436). Loss-of-function variants in HEPACAM disrupt cell adhesion and migration pathways, leading to the shared phenotypes of leukodystrophy, subcortical cysts, and abnormal cerebral white matter morphology.
